创造力
虽然布鲁诺在米兰中场的跑动和赢得对抗方面赢得了应有的赞誉，但他的创造力也使他成为欧洲最炙手可热的中场球员之一。
自从登陆英超以来，他的进球和助攻产量不断增长。上赛季纽卡斯尔没有任何球员的英超进球数超过布鲁诺。
他从运动战中创造机会的能力是一项宝贵的财富。在2022年2月以来创造超过200次机会的球员中，只有两人的运动战创造机会百分比高于我们的新援。
在该中场球员创造的213次机会中，有197次来自运动战，占比高达92.5%。
让球向前运转是布鲁诺拥有的另一项宝贵资产。在过去四年半里，只有一名中场球员的向前传球次数（2401次）超过了他。
布鲁诺将这种状态带到了世界杯上。在五场比赛中，他送出了四次助攻，这一数字仅被法国队的迈克尔·奥利塞超越。
他的稳定性也备受赞誉，自2022年冬窗加盟以来，他仅缺席了16场英超比赛。
表现神勇
布鲁诺形容与我们交手“非常艰难”，但这种感觉是相互的。
自2022年2月迎来英超首秀以来，布鲁诺对阵我们时跑动距离最远（98.6公里），赢得对抗最多（71次），超过了他对阵其他任何球队的数据。
那么布鲁诺的数据与他的新队友相比如何呢？
我们的这位夏窗新援在进球（9个）、造犯规（75次）、对抗成功（168次）以及施压次数（1749次）上都超过了我们任何一位中场球员。最重要的是，他在29场比赛中完成了1108次高强度施压，优势明显。
从每90分钟的数据来看，他的统计结果展示了米克尔·阿尔特塔在2026/27赛季前为阵容增添了一笔怎样的财富。

items.titleEn: 13 things you need to know about Bruno Guimaraes
items.summaryEn: Everything you need to know about Bruno!
bodyEn: Bruno Guimaraes has become our latest summer signing after making the move from Newcastle United.
While many would have seen Bruno face us down the years, there are several things you may not know about our new number 39.
Could he have been a swimmer? Why does he wear number 39? Here are all the things you need to know about our new Brazilian midfielder.
BUY YOUR BRUNO JERSEY NOW!
SHIRT COLLECTOR
Everyone is partial to a classic football shirt, but Bruno Guimaraes takes collecting to a whole new level.
The midfielder posted his enviable collection on Instagram, showing off shirts from across the Premier League, Europe and beyond.
He can now our new jerseys to his prized collection!
ENDING YEARS OF HURT
Bruno joined Newcastle in January 2022, helping the Magpies to from relegation candidates to Champions League qualifiers within 18 months.
The Brazilian was the heartbeat of the midfield and in March 2025, had the chance to lead out Newcastle in the Carabao Cup final at Wembley against Liverpool.
The Magpies prevailed, meaning Bruno became the first Newcastle captain since Bobby Moncur to lift a major trophy, ending 70 years without domestic silverware for the Toon Army.
OUR LATEST BRAZILIAN
Brazilian stars are no strangers to the N5 postcode.
We’ve had 15 come to Highbury and Emirates Stadium during our history, with five being signed by Mikel Arteta alone.
In August 2026, Bruno became the 16th to sign for Arsenal, and the first Brazilian central midfielder to play for us since Denilson in 2011.
BRUNO THE SPANIARD?
While Bruno is adding his name to our long list of Brazilians, could he have been joining our Spanish contingent instead?
Despite being born in Rio de Janeiro, Bruno qualified for Spanish citizenship through his grandfather, who moved to Brazil from Spain.
MAGIC 39
Numbers have significant meaning and none more so than Bruno Guimaraes wearing number 39.
The number represented his father’s taxi number when working in Brazil. The number was also handed to him while on loan at Athletico Paranaense, it was a sign beyond coincidence for the midfielder.
Writing in The Players’ Tribune in February 2023, he said: “For me 39 is special — no, it’s more than that. It's magical. The number 39 gave me everything in life.”
GOLD MEDAL GLORY
Bruno helped Brazil qualify for the Olympics in 2020, which was delayed by a year due to the pandemic.
Fast forward 12 months and Bruno was selected to play in the Olympic Games, where he helped Brazil go all the way to face Spain in the final in Tokyo.
Bruno played the full 90 minutes as Brazil triumphed 2-1 in extra-time to give our new midfielder.
BRUNO SWIMARAES
While a gold medal came in 2021, could Bruno have been standing atop another podium in a different sport?
If his mother had had her way, who wanted her son to be a swimmer instead of a footballer.
As a child, Bruno contracted pneumonia and was advised to take a sport to aid recovery. His mum pushed for him to pursue swimming, but quickly found out that football was his sport of choice.
CONFIDENCE TO SHINE
Bruno may dominate midfielders week in week out, but when he first started, the Brazilian found it hard to find his mojo.
That was until his youth team coach, Mario Jorge, who took the young midfielder under his wing to give him the confidence he needed to thrive.

Writing in The Players’ Tribune, he said: “I used to get so worked up the night before football that I’d have stomach pains and start throwing up. I’d get a headache and a fever sometimes and wouldn’t be able to fall asleep. When I played, instead of playing free, I worried about messing up.
“My coach, Mário Jorge, said ‘Listen, don’t worry about all that. Just play like it’s for fun, and see what happens. After that, I got over the “block” and developed really well.”
MAKING SACRIFICES
After being born and growing up in Rio, Bruno looked at every opportunity he had to play professional football.
Having tried out at giants Botafogo and Fluminense, but ultimately told no, Bruno signed for Audax Sao Paulo. This meant a move away from home to a new city to pursue his dream.
Despite missing home, Bruno continued to pursue his dream and after breaking into the first team at 19, he was then spotted by top division side Athletico Paranaense.
HOMELAND GLORY
Donning his beloved 39, Bruno went on loan to Athletico Paranaense before sealing a permanent switch from Audax.
His two seasons went down in history as some of the most successful in the club’s history.
In the heart of the midfield, Bruno helped Athletico win the Copa Suamericana for the first time in their history, playing both legs against Colombian side Junior.

On top of that, Bruno netted the winner in the Copa do Brasil final first leg against Internacional before winning the second leg 2-1 to clinch the trophy for the very first time. In total, Bruno won four honours before venturing over the Lyon.
UCL RUN
In January 2020, Bruno made the hop over the Atlantic and into mainland Europe to join Ligue 1 side Lyon.
Bruno made just three appearances in Ligue 1 before the Covid pandemic hit but when football returned, he helped Lyon shine on the European stage.
The midfielder first helped dump giants Juventus out on away goals before descending on Portugal for the knockout competition.
Bruno started the shock 3-1 victory over Manchester City to help Lyon reach the semi-finals of the UCL for the first time since 2010 and only the second time in their history.
FACING ARSENAL
Bruno is well accustomed to facing Arsenal since his arrival at Newcastle in January 2022.

In doing so, Bruno becomes the 38th Premier League player to play against us before becoming an Arsenal player. Since Mikel Arteta arrived at the club, he has signed 19 Premier League players who previously turned out against Arsenal.
FISHERMAN'S FRIEND
In his spare time, Bruno has a few hobbies, including going fishing with his friends.

Earlier this year Bruno was seen out fishing with world champion in spearfishing Raphael Ambrosio. The Brazilian was also seen dabbling into fishing over the summer following the World Cup in north America.

Asked about his hobbies outside of playing football, he said: “Play with my kids. My favourite hobby, I love to go to the farm, the zoo, aquarium with them, play with them. My favourite hobby is definitely to fish. I love to fish.”

items.summaryZh: 带你全面了解新援吉马良斯的背景故事。
bodyZh: 吉马良斯从纽卡斯尔联转会加盟，成为我们最新的夏窗引援。
虽然多年来许多人看过吉马良斯对阵我们，但关于我们的新39号球员，你可能还不知道几件事。
他本可能成为一名游泳运动员吗？他为什么身穿39号球衣？以下是关于这位巴西中场，你需要知道的一切。
立即购买你的吉马良斯球衣！
球衣收藏家
每个人都对经典足球球衣略有偏爱，但吉马良斯将收藏提升到了一个全新的水平。
这位中场球员在Instagram上展示了他令人艳羡的球衣收藏，其中包含来自英超、欧洲以及其他地区的球衣。
现在他可以将我们的新球衣加入他的珍贵收藏中了！
结束多年的痛苦
吉马良斯于2022年1月加盟纽卡斯尔，在18个月内帮助喜鹊从降级热门蜕变为欧冠参赛球队。
这位巴西人是中场的核心，并在2025年3月有机会率领纽卡斯尔在温布利球场对阵利物浦的联赛杯决赛中出场。
喜鹊最终获胜，这意味着吉马良斯成为自博比·蒙库尔以来第一位举起主要奖杯的纽卡斯尔队长，结束了纽卡斯尔长达70年没有国内顶级赛事冠军的历史。
我们的最新巴西球员
巴西球星对N5邮编并不陌生。
在我们的历史上，共有15名巴西球员来到海布里和酋长球场，其中有5名是阿尔特塔一人签下的。
2026年8月，吉马良斯成为第16位签约阿森纳的巴西球员，也是自2011年德尼尔森以来第一位为我们效力的巴西中场球员。
西班牙籍的吉马良斯？
虽然吉马良斯的名字被加入了我们长长的巴西球员名单，但他原本是否可以加入我们的西班牙球员阵营呢？
尽管出生于里约热内卢，但吉马良斯通过从西班牙移居巴西的祖父获得了西班牙国籍。
神奇的39号球衣
数字有着重大的意义，而吉马良斯身穿39号球衣更是如此。
这个数字代表了他在巴西工作时父亲的出租车号码。当他在巴拉纳竞技租借效力时，他也得到了这个号码，这对这位中场球员来说是一个超越巧合的信号。
他在2023年2月为《球员论坛报》撰文时表示：“对我来说，39号很特别——不，它不仅仅是特别。它是神奇的。39号给了我生命中的一切。”
金牌荣耀
吉马良斯帮助巴西队获得了2020年奥运会参赛资格，该赛事因疫情推迟了一年。
12个月后，吉马良斯被选中参加奥运会，他帮助巴西一路杀入在东京举行的决赛对阵西班牙。
吉马良斯踢满全场90分钟，巴西在加时赛中2-1取胜，为我们的新中场带来了荣誉。
游泳健将吉马良斯
虽然在2021年获得了金牌，但吉马良斯本有机会站在另一项运动的领奖台上吗？
如果按照他母亲的意愿，她希望自己的儿子成为一名游泳运动员而不是足球运动员。
小时候，吉马良斯患上肺炎，被建议通过运动来帮助恢复。他的母亲敦促他从事游泳运动，但很快发现足球才是他的首选。
闪耀的自信
吉马良斯可能在每周的中场对抗中占居主导地位，但刚开始时，这位巴西人发现很难找到自己的状态。
直到他的青年队教练马里奥·若热将这位年轻的中场球员纳入麾下，给了他茁壮成长所需的自信。
他在《球员论坛报》上写道：“在踢球的前一晚，我总是焦虑不安，甚至会胃痛并开始呕吐。有时我会头痛发烧，无法入睡。当我踢球时，我担心的不是自由地踢球，而是害怕搞砸。”
“我的教练马里奥·若热说：‘听着，别担心那些。就像玩乐一样去踢，看看会发生什么。’在那之后，我克服了‘心理障碍’，发展得非常好。”
做出牺牲
在里约出生并长大后，吉马良斯把握了每一个踢职业足球的机会。
在豪门博塔弗戈和弗鲁明塞试训但最终遭到拒绝后，吉马良斯签约了圣保罗奥达克斯。这意味着要离开家乡到一个新的城市去追求梦想。
尽管思念家园，吉马良斯依然继续追求他的梦想，在19岁进入一线队后，他被顶级联赛球队巴拉纳竞技发掘。
祖国荣耀
身披心爱的39号球衣，吉马良斯租借加盟巴拉纳竞技，随后从奥达克斯永久转会。
他的两个赛季成为了该俱乐部历史上最成功的赛季之一。
在球场中场核心位置，吉马良斯帮助巴拉纳竞技历史上首次赢得南美杯冠军，并参加了对阵哥伦比亚球队尤尼吉的客场和主场比赛。
最重要的是，吉马良斯在巴西杯决赛首回合对阵国际体育会的比赛中攻入制胜球，随后在次回合2-1取胜，首次夺得该奖杯。在前往里昂之前，吉马良斯总共赢得了四项荣誉。
欧冠征程
2020年1月，吉马良斯跨越大西洋来到欧洲大陆，加盟法甲球队里昂。
在新冠疫情爆发之前，吉马良斯仅在法甲出场三次，但当足球回归时，他帮助里昂在欧洲赛场大放异彩。
这位中场球员首先帮助球队凭借客场进球淘汰了豪门尤文图斯，然后前往葡萄牙参加淘汰赛阶段。
吉马良斯首发出场，爆冷以3-1战胜曼城，帮助里昂自2010年以来首次杀入欧冠半决赛，这也是他们队史第二次杀入半决赛。
对阵阿森纳
自从2022年1月加盟纽卡斯尔以来，吉马良斯对阵阿森纳可谓轻车熟路。
在此过程中，吉马良斯成为了在成为阿森纳球员之前对阵过我们的第38位英超球员。自从阿尔特塔执教俱乐部以来，他已经签下了19位此前曾与阿森纳交手过的英超球员。
钓鱼爱好者的朋友
在闲暇时间，吉马良斯有一些爱好，包括和朋友一起去钓鱼。
今年早些时候，吉马良斯被拍到与自由潜水捕鱼世界冠军拉斐尔·安布罗西奥一起出海钓鱼。在北美世界杯结束后，这位巴西人在夏天也涉足了钓鱼活动。
当被问及踢球之外的爱好时，他说：‘和我的孩子们玩耍。我最喜欢的爱好，我喜欢和他们去农场、动物园、水族馆，和他们一起玩。我最喜欢的爱好绝对是钓鱼。我喜欢钓鱼。’

items.titleEn: Bruno Guimaraes: 'I'm ready to be your warrior'
items.summaryEn: Check out Bruno Guimaraes' first interview as an Arsenal player!
bodyEn: Bruno Guimaraes is ready to be our warrior and build a legacy after making his move to Arsenal from Newcastle United.
The Brazilian midfielder put pen to paper on a long-term contract to bolster Mikel Arteta’s side ahead of our Premier League title defence.
In his first interview as a Gunner, Bruno stated his objective is simple: to win trophies in N5.
SHOP YOUR BRUNO JERSEY NOW!

“I'm very excited,” he said. “I’m at the point of my life where I need a challenge like this. I want to win trophies, I want to make history and I think I'm in the right place to do it. I'm so excited to start.”
Bruno is no stranger to our midfield, facing us on numerous occasions since arriving in the Premier League in 2022.
After many battles with our engine room, the Brazilian has now been welcomed by fellow midfielder Declan Rice.
He said: “Rice sent me a message: ‘Come here and please no more fights, now we’re friends!’ I was happy he messaged me.
“In my point of view, [the Arsenal midfield] is one of the best in Europe. Everyone is an amazing player.

“Every time when I play against [Arsenal] it was very tough. They keep the ball, they defend like one. I think that combination is the way I like to play as well, and of course, joining the winners of the league is always a big opportunity.”

When asked what he can bring to our midfield unit, Bruno said: “I can pass the ball, run a lot and play like a warrior, I'll never give up. I will try to help the team, [I’m] good with the ball, composed, very calm, and sometimes I can score some goals and hope to make everyone very, very happy here.”
Bruno’s career has been shaped by big moments. Winning trophies in Brazil, collecting an Olympic gold medal and lifting silverware with Newcastle. But the Brazilian wants more, much more.
“It's massive what I have done so far, but I want more. I want to win for Arsenal. I want to win more trophies in my career, and I think I'm in the right place, at my peak at 28 years old.
“I'm so excited to join. Here, wearing this shirt, you have to go for winning trophies, winning everything we can and make history.
“I want to put my name in the club history. Someday, when I leave, I want players to come here and say I want to do exactly what Bruno did for the club.
“I think it's the best thing that a player can do for the club: create history and inspire the young.”
Bruno is set to become the 17th Brazilian to play in the famous Arsenal red and there’s one former Brazilian midfielder he’s looking to emulate.

“Of course, Gilberto Silva. I love him as a player,” he said. “I had the opportunity before to talk to Gilberto Silva. I hope I can follow his history here and make myself one of the very good players at Arsenal in history.”
The midfielder will continue his tradition of wearing number 39, a number he holds close to his heart.

“It means everything to me. I have the tattoo of the 39 as well. My father was a taxi driver in Brazil for more than 20 years. The taxi, of course, gave me everything for my family, the place we live, the food, my clothes, everything.

“So when I got the chance to sign to a top club in Brazil, I asked my father which number I should take and he said 39. I was upset a little bit because I wanted to take the 97. He said: ‘No, no, take the 39. The 39 gave you everything.’

“When I got to Athletico Paranaense, I went to do the medical and when I opened [my bag], the number 39 was in there and I was very scared. I went to the kit man and I said: ‘Why 39?’ He said: ‘Well, if you don't want it, you can change it.’ I said: ‘No, no, no, it's exactly what I want!’
“At that moment, I called my father and when I told him the history, he started to cry. He said: ‘I told you, this number is going to give you luck.’ Since then, I've always been the 39.”
When delivering his message to supporters, Bruno vowed to never give up and is keen to create everlasting memories with us.

“The message for me is thank you for everything you have done. All the messages you gave me, I'm so excited to join you. I will give you my best, I promise. Like I said, I'm your warrior, I'll never give up. Hopefully we can create many, many good memories together.”
Press play to listen to the full interview with our new number 39.

items.titleZh: 吉马良斯：“我准备好成为你们的战士了”
items.summaryZh: 布鲁诺·吉马良斯在转会阿森纳后接受了首次采访，表达了对赢得冠军的渴望。
bodyZh: 在从纽卡斯尔联转会加盟阿森纳后，布鲁诺·吉马良斯（Bruno Guimaraes）已经准备好成为我们的战士并开创一番传奇。
这位巴西中场签下了一份长期合同，在英超卫冕赛季开始前增强了米克尔·阿尔特塔的阵容。
在作为枪手球员的首次采访中，布鲁诺表示他的目标很简单：在N5（酋长球场所在地）赢得冠军。
立即选购您的布鲁诺球衣！
他表示：“我非常兴奋。我正处于人生中需要这样挑战的时刻。我想赢得冠军，我想创造历史，我认为我来到了正确的地方。我太兴奋了，迫不及待想要开始。”
布鲁诺对我们的中场并不陌生，自2022年登陆英超以来，他曾多次与我们交手。
在与我们中场核心进行过多次较量后，这位巴西球员现在受到了同为中场队友的德克兰·赖斯的欢迎。
他说：“赖斯发信息给我：‘来这里吧，请不要再打架了，现在我们是朋友了！’他发信息给我时我很高兴。
“在我看来，[阿森纳中场]是欧洲最好的中场之一。每个人都是出色的球员。
“每次与[阿森纳]比赛都非常艰难。他们控球，他们像一个人一样防守。我认为这种组合也是我喜欢踢球的方式，当然，加入联赛冠军始终是一个巨大的机会。”
当被问及他能为我们的中场带来什么时，布鲁诺说：“我能传球、跑动很多，并且像个战士一样踢球，我绝不会放弃。我会努力帮助球队，[我]脚下技术好、沉着、非常冷静，有时我能进几个球，希望让这里的每个人都非常非常快乐。”
布鲁诺的职业生涯由重大时刻塑造。在巴西赢得冠军，获得奥运会金牌，并与纽卡斯尔举起奖杯。但这位巴西人想要更多，多得多。
“到目前为止我所取得的成就已经很巨大了，但我想要更多。我想为阿森纳赢得胜利。我想在职业生涯中赢得更多冠军，我认为我正处于28岁的巅峰期，来到了正确的地方。
“我非常高兴能加盟。在这里，身披这件球衣，你必须为赢得冠军而战，赢得我们所能赢得的一切并创造历史。
“我想把我的名字写进俱乐部历史。总有一天，当我离开时，我希望球员们来到这里时说，我想做布鲁诺为俱乐部所做的事情。
“我认为这是一个球员能为俱乐部做的最好的事情：创造历史并激励年轻人。”
布鲁诺将成为第17位效力于著名的阿森纳红白战袍的巴西球员，他有一位前巴西中场效仿的对象。
“当然是吉尔伯托·席尔瓦。我作为球员非常崇拜他，”他说。“我以前有机会和吉尔伯托·席尔瓦交谈。我希望我能延续他在的历史，让自己成为阿森纳历史上非常优秀的球员之一。”
这位中场将延续身披39号球衣的传统，这个号码在他心中有着特殊的地位。
“这对意味着一切。我也纹了39号的纹身。我的父亲在巴西做出租车司机超过20年。出租车当然为我的家庭提供了一切，我们住的地方、食物、我的衣服，一切。
“所以当我得到机会签约巴西顶级俱乐部时，我问父亲我应该选哪个号码，他说39号。我有点沮丧，因为我想选97号。他说：‘不，不，选39号。39号给了你一切。’
“当我到达巴拉纳竞技时，我去进行体检，当我打开[包]时，39号就在里面，我非常害怕。我去找装备管理员说：‘为什么是39？’他说：‘好吧，如果你不想要，你可以换。’我说：‘不，不，不，这正是我想要的！’
“那一刻，我给父亲打电话，当我把这个故事告诉他时，他开始哭了。他说：‘我告诉你，这个号码会给你带来好运。’从那时起，我一直都是39号。”
在向支持者传递信息时，布鲁诺发誓绝不放弃，并渴望与我们创造永恒的记忆。
“我想传达的信息是感谢你们所做的一切。你们给我的所有信息，我很高兴能加入你们。我会竭尽全力，我保证。就像我说的，我是你们的战士，我绝不会放弃。希望我们能一起创造很多很多美好的回忆。”

items.titleEn: Bruno Guimaraes joins Arsenal
items.summaryEn: We are delighted to announce the signing of Bruno Guimaraes on a long-term deal
bodyEn: We are delighted to announce that Brazil international Bruno Guimaraes has joined us from Newcastle United on a long-term contract.
Bruno joins us having established himself as one of the most influential players in the Premier League.

The 28-year-old began his professional career in his home country, making his senior debut for Sao Paulo-based side Audax in 2015, before joining Athletico Paranaense two years later. During his time with Athletico, Bruno established himself as one of Brazil’s brightest young midfielders, helping the club win four major trophies, before earning a move to French side Lyon in January 2020. Across two impressive seasons in Ligue 1, Bruno further enhanced his reputation as one of Europe’s outstanding midfield talents.

Bruno joined Newcastle United in January 2022 and went on to make nearly 200 appearances during four-and-a-half seasons at St James’ Park. A commanding presence in midfield, he played a pivotal role in Newcastle’s Carabao Cup triumph in 2025 and helped the club secure qualification for the UEFA Champions League across two seasons.

An established international, Bruno has made 48 appearances for Brazil and has represented his country on the biggest stages of the game. He was part of Brazil’s squad at the recent FIFA World Cup, and has also featured in the Copa America, and won a gold medal at the 2020 Olympic Games in Tokyo.
Sporting Director, Andrea Berta said: “We are delighted to welcome Bruno Guimaraes to our club.
“Bruno is a player with a great mentality and great quality, who will bring strong leadership to our squad.

“With Bruno joining us, we are further strengthening the heart of our team. As we have all seen, Bruno can play as a defensive midfielder and as a box-to-box player. He combines quality with quantity, and has provided goals and assists for his team every year.

“Bruno will allow Mikel to further develop our playing style and will also increase our internal competitiveness, which is essential for maintaining the standards required when we are aiming to win major trophies.”
Bruno will wear the number 39 shirt for the club and join up with his new team mates immediately.
Everyone at Arsenal warmly welcomes Bruno and his family to the club.
The transfer is subject to the completion of regulatory processes.

items.titleZh: 布鲁诺·吉马良斯加盟阿森纳
items.summaryZh: 我们高兴地宣布，巴西国脚布鲁诺·吉马良斯以长期合同加盟阿森纳。
bodyZh: 我们非常高兴地宣布，巴西国脚布鲁诺·吉马良斯（Bruno Guimaraes）从纽卡斯尔联转会加盟阿森纳，并签下一份长期合同。
布鲁诺加盟时，已确立了自己在英超联赛中最具影响力的球员之一的地位。
这位28岁的球员在祖国开启了职业生涯，于2015年在圣保罗的奥达克斯完成一线队首秀，两年后加盟巴拉纳竞技。在巴拉纳竞技效力期间，布鲁诺确立了自己作为巴西最耀眼年轻中场之一的地位，帮助俱乐部赢得四座重要奖杯，随后于2020年1月转会法甲里昂。在法甲经历两个出色的赛季后，布鲁诺进一步巩固了自己作为欧洲杰出中场天才之一的声誉。
布鲁诺于2022年1月加盟纽卡斯尔联，在圣詹姆斯公园度过四个半赛季期间出场近200次。作为中场的核心力量，他在纽卡斯尔联2025年联赛杯夺冠过程中发挥了关键作用，并帮助俱乐部在两个赛季中获得欧洲冠军联赛参赛资格。
作为一名资深国脚，布鲁诺已为巴西队出场48次，并在世界最大赛场上代表国家队出战。他曾随巴西队参加最近的国际足联世界杯，也参加过美洲杯，并在2020年东京奥运会上赢得金牌。
体育总监安德烈·贝尔塔表示：“我们非常高兴欢迎布鲁诺·吉马良斯来到我们的俱乐部。”
“布鲁诺是一位具备极佳心态和出色能力的球员，他将为我们的阵容带来强大的领导力。”
“随着布鲁诺的加盟，我们进一步加强了球队的中场核心。正如我们大家所看到的，布鲁诺既能踢防守型中场，也能踢全能中场。他兼具质量与跑动量，每年都能为球队贡献进球和助攻。”
“布鲁诺将让米克尔进一步发展我们的比赛风格，同时也将提升我们的队内竞争力，这对于保持我们争夺重大奖杯时所需的标准至关重要。”
布鲁诺将身披俱乐部39号球衣，并立即与新队友会合。
阿森纳的每个人都热烈欢迎布鲁诺及其家人来到俱乐部。

items.titleEn: Arteta reflects on "disappointing" draw at Forest
items.summaryEn: The manager rues missed chances in our goalless draw at the City Ground
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta believes we generated enough chances to beat Nottingham Forest on Saturday, as he reflected on our second consecutive goalless draw in the Premier League.
It’s the first time since 2012/13 that we have recorded back-to-back 0-0 draws in the league, and the boss said it was "difficult to generate momentum" during the game.
“We came here to win the game, that's clear, and we needed the opportunities that we had,” he said at full-time.

“We haven't managed that, so the word is disappointment. We haven't conceded anything, any single shot again and generated four massive chances with Martinelli with an open goal, with Declan Rice, Merino and then Bukayo Saka's header with an unbelievable save, and on top of that, a very clear penalty as well that has not been given.
“So after that, it’s pretty difficult for us because it's a team that is very well organised and very difficult to generate a lot of momentum throughout the game, so it's disappointing.”
The penalty appeal was for an apparent handball against Ola Aina late on, which VAR reviewed, but Mikel admitted his main frustration was with the squandered chances.

“You need [to take chances], especially to open them up, especially the way that they played,” the boss added. “We tried in many ways, we made changes, we tried to have more people in the last line, to have very creative players in and around the box. When you get into those moments, you have to make it happen if you want to win and we didn’t manage to get it done.”

The game was our third away match in a run of four in a row across a period of just 10 days, sandwiched between the Carabao Cup semi-final first leg away to Chelsea last Wednesday, and our trip to Inter Milan in the Champions League this Tuesday.

“At the end, it's another little step and the schedule is very, very demanding,” Mikel said. “We came two and a half days ago to play against Chelsea in the semi-final, they both made a huge effort. We have a game in three days against Inter Milan, then Man United, so yeah, reflect today and tomorrow we go again.”

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔谈客平森林：“令人失望”
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳主帅对在城市球场互交白卷感到失望，并指出球队错失了多次绝佳进球良机。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔认为，我们在周六对阵诺丁汉森林的比赛中创造了足够取胜的机会，并回顾了我们在英超联赛中遭遇的连续第二场闷平。
这是自2012/13赛季以来，我们首次在联赛中遭遇背靠背的0比0平局，主教练表示比赛期间“很难形成连续的攻势”。
他在赛后说道：“我们来这里就是为了赢球，这是显而易见的，我们也需要我们曾拥有的那些机会。”
“我们没能把握住，所以这个词就是失望。我们没有给对手任何机会，再次没有让对手完成哪怕一次射门，并且创造了四个绝佳机会：马丁内利面对空门、德克兰·赖斯、梅里诺，还有布卡约·萨卡不可思议的头球扑救，最重要的是，还有一个非常明显的点球没有判。”
“所以在这之后，这对我们来说相当困难，因为这是一支组织非常严密的球队，在整场比赛中很难带动出很多气势，所以这令人失望。”
关于点球的申诉是因为比赛尾声阶段奥拉·埃纳疑似手球，VAR对此进行了回看，但米克尔承认他主要的挫败感还是来自于挥霍的机会。
主教练补充道：“你必须（把握住机会），特别是为了打破僵局，特别是考虑到他们的踢法。我们尝试了多种方法，我们做出调整，试图在防线最后安排更多人，在禁区内及周边安排极具创造力的球员。当你进入那些时刻时，如果你想赢球，你就必须让它发生，而我们没能做到。”
这场比赛是我们十天内连续四个客场之旅中的第三场，此前我们在上周三客场对阵切尔西的联赛杯半决赛首回合，接下来我们将在本周二远征国际米兰的欧冠赛场。
米克尔说：“归根结底，这是又迈出的一小步，赛程非常非常严峻。我们在两天半前刚踢完对阵切尔西的半决赛，双方都付出了巨大的努力。我们在三天后还有对阵国际米兰的比赛，然后是对阵曼联，所以是的，今天进行总结，明天我们重新出发。”
